summary: Extended the EXISTING single-click HandleClick/TryMark path into a drag-rect marquee. Left-mouse-DOWN in deconstruct mode records start world cell + shows a code-generated DANGER_RED translucent selection quad (1x1 white Sprite stretched, snapped to whole cells, sortingOrder 29 — no prefab). Left-mouse-UP: near-zero drag (< dragClickThreshold 0.35u) -> existing single-cell HandleClick unchanged; real drag -> SweepBox iterates EVERY cell in the box, reusing the EXACT per-cell Physics2D.OverlapBoxAll+TryMark path (no new pathfinding/dispatch — DispatchToIdleBuilders already handles N targets) to (1) mark each deconstructable structure and (2) CANCEL each unbuilt BlueprintEntity. SweepBox returns affected-count and is public for the B12-verify harness.
